findings.title: Debug Seed Text Leak
findings.where: Arena screen, top-left corner beneath the WEAPONS header
findings.problem: Debug text reading "Seed alice5ee" (or similar seed identifier) is visible beneath the weapons UI, appearing as unfinished debug information
findings.why: It breaks fourth-wall immersion and signals an unpolished/development build to the player, reducing perceived quality and professionalism
findings.fix: Remove the debug seed text from the UI layer in production builds, or gate it behind a developer-only flag; replace with the active weapon name or hide entirely when no weapon is selected

findings.title: Radar Non-Functionality
findings.where: Arena and road screens, bottom-left corner
findings.problem: The radar is rendered as a nearly black circular disc with no visible sweep line, contact dots, or grid lines, making it read as a broken or decorative element rather than a functional instrument
findings.why: At highway speeds, players need immediate spatial awareness of enemies/obstacles; a non-functional radar removes critical gameplay information and looks like a rendering failure
findings.fix: Add a bright, rotating sweep line (cyan/green), render enemy contacts as pulsing red/orange dots, and ensure the outer ring and grid have sufficient contrast (light gray on dark) to be visible

findings.title: Minimap Boundary Indistinctness
findings.problem: The circular boundary wall is rendered in low-contrast gray against the cracked earth texture, and building interaction icons (colored arrows) are small and lack visual weight against the detailed background
findings.why: Players cannot quickly identify the playable area limits or distinguish interactive points of interest, causing navigation delays and visual fatigue
findings.fix: Increase boundary wall opacity to 80-100% with a bright white or cyan color, add a subtle outer glow/shadow to separate it from the ground texture, and scale up building icons by 20-30% with saturated colors and white borders

findings.title: Armour Status Confusion
findings.where: Arena and road screens, top-right condition panel
findings.problem: All armour zones (Front, Rear, Left, Right, Underbody) display "0/0" in red text, which visually communicates "damaged/destroyed" state rather than "no armour equipped", and the horizontal bars are empty without indicating availability
findings.why: Players misinterpret the red zeros as critical vehicle damage, creating false urgency and confusion about whether their car is destroyed or simply unarmoured
findings.fix: Render empty slots as "--" or "0/0" in neutral gray, add a dashed border or "+" icon to indicate the slot is available for mounting, and reserve red exclusively for actual damage states with health remaining

findings.title: Weapon Slot Ambiguity
findings.where: Constructor screen, left-hand panel weapon list
findings.problem: Weapon rows 1-10 display "(empty)" in low-contrast, muted text that is difficult to read against the dark background and appears disabled rather than available
findings.why: Players cannot quickly identify which mounting points are free for weapons, and the dim text suggests the slots are inaccessible rather than empty, slowing down the build process
findings.fix: Increase contrast of "(empty)" text to bright cyan or white, add a subtle left border or "+" indicator to signal interactivity, and ensure hover/selected states are visually distinct from the static list
